info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Banking Facilities Equipment Maintenances-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Facilities Equipment Maintenance API provides a comprehensive overview of maintenance records for banking facilities' equipment. This API allows users to retrieve detailed information on equipment maintenance activities, ensuring optimal performance and compliance. Typical consumers include facility managers and maintenance coordinators seeking to monitor and manage equipment upkeep efficiently. Utilize this API to access historical and current maintenance data, facilitating better decision-making and resource allocation.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of equipment maintenance records for facilities.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed records of maintenance activities performed on equipment within facilities. It aids in tracking the maintenance history and planning future upkeep for improved operational efficiency.

requestBody.description: Retrieve details about the maintenance operations for facilities' equipment. The request body must conform to the specified schema, which defines the structure and data types for the operation. Ensure that the JSON provided adheres to the required format.

ListBankingFacilitiesEquipmentMaintenanc.description: A request body that is a string representation for the operations in equipment maintenance.
